title: Hypercentric optics: A camera lens that can see behind objects
summary: Applied Science shows how telecentric and hypercentric optics differ from normal lenses, producing no or negative perspective. The video builds a telecentric system from a Fresnel lens and demonstrates a lens that can see around objects.
why: Commenters cite it as the clearest demonstration of hypercentric lenses and of looking around objects with optics.

quote.text: Applied Science has a good video[1] showing how you can look around objects.
